```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

cat > /usr/local/bin/systemd-hardening-audit.sh << 'AUDITSCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

OUTPUT_DIR="${2:-/var/log/systemd-audit}"
FORMAT="${1:---text}"
REPORT_FILE="${OUTPUT_DIR}/hardening-report-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
JSON_FILE="${REPORT_FILE}.json"
TEXT_FILE="${REPORT_FILE}.txt"
TEMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$TEMP_DIR"' EXIT

mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

echo "========================================"
echo " systemd Hardening Audit"
echo " Date: $(date)"
echo " Host: $(hostname)"
echo "========================================"

# Get all enabled services (non-template, non-alias)
ENABLED_SERVICES=$(systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --state=enabled,enabled-runtime --no-legend 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | grep -v '@' | sort -u)

if [ -z "$ENABLED_SERVICES" ]; then
  echo "No enabled services found."
  exit 1
fi

echo "Analyzing $(echo "$ENABLED_SERVICES" | wc -l) services..."
echo ""

RESULTS_JSON="["
FIRST_ENTRY=true

analyze_service() {
  local svc="$1"
  local analysis_file="${TEMP_DIR}/${svc}.txt"

  systemd-analyze security "$svc" > "$analysis_file" 2>/dev/null || return 1

  local exposure_line=$(head -1 "$analysis_file" 2>/dev/null)
  local exposure_level=$(echo "$exposure_line" | grep -oP '(UNSAFE|MEDIUM|SAFE|OK)' || echo "UNKNOWN")
  local exposure_score=$(echo "$exposure_line" | grep -oP '[0-9]+\.[0-9]*' || echo "0")
  local unsafe=$(grep -c '!' "$analysis_file" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
  local medium=$(grep -c '⊙' "$analysis_file" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")

  if [ "$FIRST_ENTRY" = true ]; then
    FIRST_ENTRY=false
  else
    RESULTS_JSON+=","
  fi

  RESULTS_JSON+='{"service":"'$svc'","exposure_level":"'$exposure_level'","exposure_score":'$exposure_score',"unsafe":'$unsafe',"medium":'$medium'}'

  echo "[$exposure_level] $svc (score: $exposure_score)" >> "${TEMP_DIR}/sorted.txt"
}

for svc in $ENABLED_SERVICES; do
  analyze_service "$svc" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo -n "."
done
echo ""

RESULTS_JSON+="]"

# Sort by exposure level
SORTED_REPORT=$(cat "${TEMP_DIR}/sorted.txt" 2>/dev/null | sort -r || echo "")

# Write JSON report
echo "$RESULTS_JSON" | python3 -m json.tool 2>/dev/null > "$JSON_FILE" || echo "$RESULTS_JSON" > "$JSON_FILE"

# Write text report
cat > "$TEXT_FILE" << EOF
========================================
 systemd Hardening Audit Report
 Generated: $(date)
 Hostname: $(hostname)
 Services Analyzed: $(echo "$ENABLED_SERVICES" | wc -l)
========================================
EOF

echo "" >> "$TEXT_FILE"
echo "UNSAFE services:" >> "$TEXT_FILE"
echo "$SORTED_REPORT" | grep "UNSAFE" >> "$TEXT_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "  (none)" >> "$TEXT_FILE"
echo "" >> "$TEXT_FILE"
echo "MEDIUM services:" >> "$TEXT_FILE"
echo "$SORTED_REPORT" | grep "MEDIUM" >> "$TEXT_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "  (none)" >> "$TEXT_FILE"
echo "" >> "$TEXT_FILE"
echo "SAFE services:" >> "$TEXT_FILE"
echo "$SORTED_REPORT" | grep "SAFE" >> "$TEXT_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "  (none)" >> "$TEXT_FILE"
echo "" >> "$TEXT_FILE"
echo "OK services:" >> "$TEXT_FILE"
echo "$SORTED_REPORT" | grep "OK" >> "$TEXT_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "  (none)" >> "$TEXT_FILE"

cat >> "$TEXT_FILE" << RECEOF

TOP RECOMMENDATIONS
-------------------
1. Add PrivateTmp=true
2. Add ProtectSystem=strict
3. Add ProtectHome=true
4. Add NoNewPrivileges=yes
5. Add CapabilityBoundingSet=~ CAP_SYS_ADMIN
6. Add PrivateDevices=true
7. Add ProtectKernelTunables=true
8. Add ProtectControlGroups=true
9. Add SystemCallArchitectures=native
10. Add IPAddressDeny=any
RECEOF

echo ""
echo "Reports generated:"
echo "  Text: $TEXT_FILE"
echo "  JSON: $JSON_FILE"
echo ""
echo "UNSAFE: $(grep -c UNSAFE "${TEMP_DIR}/sorted.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
echo "MEDIUM: $(grep -c MEDIUM "${TEMP_DIR}/sorted.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
echo "SAFE:   $(grep -c SAFE "${TEMP_DIR}/sorted.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
echo "OK:     $(grep -c OK "${TEMP_DIR}/sorted.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"

logger -t hardening-audit "Systemd hardening audit complete"
AUDITSCRIPT

chmod +x /usr/local/bin/systemd-hardening-audit.sh

echo "=== Running audit ==="
/usr/local/bin/systemd-hardening-audit.sh --text /var/log/systemd-audit 2>&1 || echo "Audit completed (some services may have been skipped)"
```

```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# 1. Check kernel support
echo "=== Step 1: Verify kernel support ==="
KERNEL=$(uname -r | cut -d. -f1-2)
if awk 'BEGIN {exit !('"$KERNEL"' >= 5.11)}' 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "Kernel $KERNEL supports ProtectProc (>= 5.11)"
else
  echo "WARNING: Kernel $KERNEL may not fully support ProtectProc=invisible"
fi

# Check proc mount options
if grep -q 'hidepid=invisible' /proc/mounts 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "procfs already mounted with hidepid=invisible"
else
  echo "procfs may not have hidepid option. ProtectProc applies per-process namespace."
  echo "For system-wide effect: mount -o remount,hidepid=invisible /proc"
fi

# 2. Create hiddenuser
echo "=== Step 2: Create hidden user ==="
getent passwd hiddenuser >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m -s /bin/bash hiddenuser
getent passwd otheruser >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m -s /bin/bash otheruser

# 3. Create the hidden process service
echo "=== Step 3: Create hidden-proc.service ==="
cat > /etc/systemd/system/hidden-proc.service << 'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Process hidden from other users via ProtectProc
Documentation=man:systemd.exec(5)

[Service]
Type=simple
User=hiddenuser
Group=hiddenuser
ProtectProc=invisible
ProcSubset=ptmx
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/visible-check.sh
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT

# 4. Create the check script
echo "=== Step 4: Create check script ==="
cat > /usr/local/bin/visible-check.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
echo "=== Inside the service (UID $(id -u)) ==="
echo "Process PID: $$"
echo ""
echo "Self-view (ps aux | grep $$):"
ps aux | grep "$$" || true
echo ""
echo "Service will remain running for external inspection."
echo "From another user: ps aux | grep visible-check"
echo "From root:         ps aux | grep visible-check (still visible)"
sleep infinity
SCRIPT
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/visible-check.sh

# 5. Start service
echo "=== Step 5: Start ==="
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now hidden-proc.service
sleep 2

# 6. Demonstrate visibility
echo ""
echo "=== Step 6: Visibility demonstration ==="
THEPID=$(systemctl show hidden-proc.service -p MainPID --value)
echo "Service PID: $THEPID"

echo ""
echo "--- As root (visible) ---"
ps -p $THEPID -o pid,user,comm 2>/dev/null || echo "Process not running"

echo ""
echo "--- As otheruser (simulate with su) ---"
su -s /bin/bash -c "ps aux | grep visible-check || echo '(hidden - no output)'" otheruser 2>/dev/null || echo "Cannot switch user"

echo ""
echo "--- /proc/$THEPID from other user perspective ---"
su -s /bin/bash -c "ls -la /proc/$THEPID/status 2>&1 || echo 'Permission denied (hidden as expected)'" otheruser 2>/dev/null

echo ""
echo "=== EXPLANATION ==="
echo "ProtectProc=invisible: Makes process invisible to non-root users via /proc."
echo "  - Other users: cannot see the process in ps/top or read /proc/<pid>/*"
echo "  - Root: still sees everything"
echo "ProtectProc=default: Normal visibility (all users can see)"
echo "ProtectProc=noaccess: Process visible but /proc/<pid> inaccessible to non-root"
```

```bash
echo "=== Step 3: Create app-with-creds.sh ==="
cat > /usr/local/bin/app-with-creds.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "=== Application with Credentials ==="
echo "Started at $(date)"
echo "Running as: $(whoami) (UID: $(id -u))"
echo ""

# Load environment variables from file (already done by systemd EnvironmentFile)
echo "=== Environment Configuration ==="
echo "APP_ENV: ${APP_ENV:-not set}"
echo "APP_PORT: ${APP_PORT:-not set}"
echo "DB_HOST: ${DB_HOST:-not set}"
echo "DB_NAME: ${DB_NAME:-not set}"
echo ""

# Read credential from $CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY
echo "=== Secrets from LoadCredential ==="
if [ -d "${CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY:-}" ]; then
  echo "Credentials directory: $CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY"
  echo "Contents:"
  ls -la "$CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY/"
  echo ""
  if [ -f "${CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY}/db-password" ]; then
    DB_PASS=$(cat "${CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY}/db-password")
    echo "DB Password: $DB_PASS"
    echo "Password length: ${#DB_PASS} characters"
  else
    echo "ERROR: db-password credential not found at $CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY/db-password"
    exit 1
  fi
else
  echo "ERROR: CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY not set or not found"
  exit 1
fi

echo ""
echo "Verification complete. Service running..."

# Show that credentials are not visible in /proc
echo ""
echo "Check that password is NOT visible in /proc:"
echo "  grep -r 's3cur3' /proc/$$/cmdline 2>/dev/null || echo '[PASS] Not in cmdline'"
echo "  grep -r 's3cur3' /proc/$$/environ 2>/dev/null || echo '[PASS] Not in environ'"

tail -f /dev/null
SCRIPT
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/app-with-creds.sh

# 4. Create the service
echo "=== Step 4: Create cred.service ==="
cat > /etc/systemd/system/cred.service << 'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Service with secure credential management
Documentation=man:systemd.exec(5)

[Service]
Type=simple
User=nobody
Group=nogroup
EnvironmentFile=-/etc/app/config.env
LoadCredential=db-password:/etc/credentials/db-password
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/app-with-creds.sh
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT

# 5. Start and verify
echo "=== Step 5: Start service ==="
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now cred.service
sleep 2

echo ""
echo "=== Step 6: Verify ==="
systemctl status cred.service --no-pager --lines=30 2>&1 || true

echo ""
echo "=== Security Check ==="
echo "Credentials file permissions:"
ls -la /etc/credentials/db-password

echo ""
echo "EnvironmentFile vs LoadCredential:"
echo "- EnvironmentFile: Reads into process environment (visible in /proc/PID/environ)"
echo "- LoadCredential:  Stores in /run/credentials/UNIT/ (ramfs, not in environ)"
echo "- The - prefix in EnvironmentFile=-/etc/app/config.env means 'optional'"
```

```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# 1. Create the inbound directory
echo "=== Step 1: Create inbound directory ==="
mkdir -p /opt/inbound
chmod 755 /opt/inbound

# 2. Create the processing script
echo "=== Step 2: Create process-csv.sh ==="
cat > /usr/local/bin/process-csv.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "========================================"
echo "CSV Processing triggered at $(date)"
echo "========================================"

INBOUND_DIR="/opt/inbound"
PROCESSED_DIR="/opt/inbound/processed"
mkdir -p "$PROCESSED_DIR"

# Count files before processing
TOTAL=$(ls "${INBOUND_DIR}"/*.csv 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
if [ "$TOTAL" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "No CSV files found in $INBOUND_DIR (DirectoryNotEmpty triggered, but glob may not match)"
  exit 0
fi

echo "Found $TOTAL CSV files to process:"

for csv in "${INBOUND_DIR}"/*.csv; do
  [ -f "$csv" ] || continue
  BASENAME=$(basename "$csv")
  echo "  Processing: $BASENAME"
  
  # Simulate processing
  LINES=$(wc -l < "$csv")
  echo "    Lines: $LINES"
  echo "    Content preview:"
  head -3 "$csv" | sed 's/^/      /'
  
  # Mark processing timestamp
  echo "Processed at $(date)" >> "$csv.processed"
  
  # Move to processed
  mv "$csv" "${PROCESSED_DIR}/${BASENAME}.$(date +%s)"
  echo "    Moved to ${PROCESSED_DIR}/"
done

echo ""
echo "Processing complete at $(date)"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/process-csv.sh

# 3. Create the processing service (Type=oneshot)
echo "=== Step 3: Create process-inbound.service ==="
cat > /etc/systemd/system/process-inbound.service << 'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Process inbound CSV files

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/process-csv.sh
User=nobody
Group=nogroup
UNIT

# 4. Create the path unit
echo "=== Step 4: Create inbound.path ==="
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inbound.path << 'PATHUNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Monitor inbound directory for CSV files

[Path]
DirectoryNotEmpty=/opt/inbound
PathExistsGlob=/opt/inbound/*.csv
Unit=process-inbound.service

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
PATHUNIT

# 5. Enable and start the path unit
echo "=== Step 5: Enable path monitor ==="
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inbound.path

# 6. Test by creating CSV files
echo "=== Step 6: Test by creating CSV files ==="
echo ""
echo "Creating test CSV files in /opt/inbound..."

cat > /opt/inbound/data1.csv << 'CSV1'
id,name,value
1,Alice,100
2,Bob,200
3,Charlie,300
CSV1

echo "Created data1.csv"

sleep 2

cat > /opt/inbound/data2.csv << 'CSV2'
id,name,value
4,Diana,400
5,Eve,500
CSV2

echo "Created data2.csv"
sleep 3

# 7. Verify
echo ""
echo "=== Step 7: Verification ==="
echo ""
echo "Path unit status:"
systemctl status inbound.path --no-pager --lines=15

echo ""
echo "Service status (should show oneshot runs):"
systemctl status process-inbound.service --no-pager --lines=20 2>/dev/null || true

echo ""
echo "Journal entries:"
journalctl -u process-inbound.service --no-pager --lines=10 || echo "No journal entries yet"

echo ""
echo "Processed files:"
ls -la /opt/inbound/processed/ 2>/dev/null || echo "No files processed yet"
```

This is a comprehensive multi-service stack using systemd to orchestrate 5 interdependent services plus a target to bundle them. Caddy serves as reverse proxy on port 443 terminating TLS and forwarding to FastAPI on port 8000. The FastAPI service uses Type=notify (sd_notify) for proper readiness signaling. PostgreSQL gets a drop-in override limiting memory to 2G. Celery worker has CPUQuota=200% (2 cores) and Restart=always. Redis is a dependency for Celery. The app-stack.target bundles all with Wants= and After= for proper ordering. Edge cases: Type=notify requires the application to call sd_notify(0, "READY=1"); Wants= allows services to start even if dependencies fail; After= ensures ordering but not strict dependency.
</think>

```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "========================================"
echo " Complete Application Stack with systemd"
echo "========================================"
echo ""

# ============================================================
# SERVICE 1: Redis (dependency for Celery)
# ============================================================
echo "=== Step 1: Redis service (celery backend) ==="
cat > /etc/systemd/system/redis.service << 'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Redis in-memory data store
Documentation=https://redis.io/documentation
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=notify
ExecStart=/usr/bin/redis-server /etc/redis/redis.conf --daemonize no
ExecStop=/usr/bin/redis-cli shutdown
ExecReload=/usr/bin/redis-cli save
TimeoutStopSec=30
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

# Resource limits
MemoryMax=512M
CPUQuota=100%

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT

# ============================================================
# SERVICE 2: PostgreSQL (database)
# ============================================================
echo ""
echo "=== Step 2: PostgreSQL service with memory limit ==="
cat > /etc/systemd/system/postgresql.service << 'UNIT2'
[Unit]
Description=PostgreSQL database server
Documentation=https://www.postgresql.org/docs/
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=notify
ExecStart=/usr/bin/postgresql -D /var/lib/postgresql/data
ExecReload=/bin/kill -HUP $MAINPID
TimeoutStopSec=60
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10

# Memory limit via drop-in
MemoryMax=2G
MemoryHigh=1.8G

# I/O tuning
IOWeight=500

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT2

# Create drop-in for PostgreSQL overrides
mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/postgresql.service.d
cat > /etc/systemd/system/postgresql.service.d/memory-limit.conf << 'DROPIN'
[Service]
MemoryMax=2G
MemoryHigh=1.8G
IOWeight=500
DROPIN

# ============================================================
# SERVICE 3: FastAPI (Gunicorn + Uvicorn)
# ============================================================
echo ""
echo "=== Step 3: FastAPI API service ==="
cat > /etc/systemd/system/api.service << 'UNIT3'
[Unit]
Description=FastAPI application server (Gunicorn + Uvicorn)
Documentation=https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/
After=network.target postgresql.service redis.service
Requires=postgresql.service
Wants=redis.service

[Service]
Type=notify
User=appuser
Group=appuser
WorkingDirectory=/opt/app
Environment=PYTHONPATH=/opt/app
EnvironmentFile=-/etc/app/api.env
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/gunicorn -w 4 -k uvicorn.workers.UvicornWorker -b 127.0.0.1:8000 app.main:app --access-logfile /var/log/app/api-access.log --error-logfile /var/log/app/api-error.log
ExecReload=/bin/kill -HUP $MAINPID
TimeoutStartSec=60
TimeoutStopSec=30
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10

# Security hardening
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
SystemCallArchitectures=native

# Notify systemd when ready (requires app to call sd_notify)
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=main

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT3

# ============================================================
# SERVICE 4: Celery Worker (background tasks)
# ============================================================
echo ""
echo "=== Step 4: Celery worker service ==="
cat > /etc/systemd/system/celery-worker.service << 'UNIT4'
[Unit]
Description=Celery background task worker
Documentation=https://docs.celeryq.dev/
After=network.target redis.service api.service
Requires=redis.service
Wants=api.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=appuser
Group=appuser
WorkingDirectory=/opt/app
EnvironmentFile=-/etc/app/celery.env
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/celery -A app.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=4 -n worker1@%%h
ExecStop=/usr/local/bin/celery -A app.celery_app control shutdown
Restart=always
RestartSec=10

# Resource limits for CPU-heavy tasks
CPUQuota=200%
MemoryMax=1G
TasksMax=512

# Security
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=full

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT4

# ============================================================
# SERVICE 5: Caddy (Reverse Proxy)
# ============================================================
echo ""
echo "=== Step 5: Caddy reverse proxy ==="
cat > /etc/systemd/system/caddy.service << 'UNIT5'
[Unit]
Description=Caddy web server (reverse proxy)
Documentation=https://caddyserver.com/docs/
After=network.target network-online.target api.service
Requires=api.service

[Service]
Type=notify
User=caddy
Group=caddy
ExecStart=/usr/bin/caddy run --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --environ
ExecReload=/usr/bin/caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
TimeoutStopSec=30
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

# Capabilities for privileged ports
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE
AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE
NoNewPrivileges=yes

# Security hardening
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT5

# Create Caddyfile
mkdir -p /etc/caddy
cat > /etc/caddy/Caddyfile << 'CADDY'
api.example.com {
    reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8000
    log {
        output file /var/log/caddy/api-access.log
    }
}
CADDY

# ============================================================
# TARGET: app-stack.target (bundle all services)
# ============================================================
echo ""
echo "=== Step 6: Create app-stack.target ==="
cat > /etc/systemd/system/app-stack.target << 'TARGET'
[Unit]
Description=Complete application stack target
Documentation=man:systemd.target(5)

# Service dependencies
Wants=caddy.service api.service postgresql.service celery-worker.service redis.service

# Ordering (not strict requires - Wants allows partial startup)
After=network.target network-online.target
Requires=redis.service postgresql.service

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
TARGET

# ============================================================
# FINAL: Enable and verify
# ============================================================
echo ""
echo "=== Step 7: Enable all services ==="
systemctl daemon-reload

# Enable the target (which pulls in all services via Wants)
systemctl enable app-stack.target

# Also explicitly enable each service
for svc in redis postgresql api celery-worker caddy; do
  systemctl enable "${svc}.service" 2>/dev/null || echo "  $svc.service enable skipped"
done

echo ""
echo "=== Step 8: Verify dependencies ==="
echo ""
echo "Dependency tree for app-stack.target:"
systemctl list-dependencies app-stack.target --no-pager 2>/dev/null || echo "Target not yet started"

echo ""
echo "=== STACK OVERVIEW ==="
echo ""
echo "  Service          | Type      | Port | Role                          |"
echo "  -----------------|-----------|------|-------------------------------|"
echo "  caddy.service    | notify    | 443  | Reverse proxy (TLS)            |"
echo "  api.service      | notify    | 8000 | FastAPI + Gunicorn             |"
echo "  postgresql.svc   | notify    | 5432 | Database (2G mem limit)        |"
echo "  celery-worker.svc| simple    |  -   | Background tasks (200% CPU)    |"
echo "  redis.service    | notify    | 6379 | Celery backend / cache         |"
echo "  app-stack.target | target    |  -   | Orchestrator (Wants all)       |"

echo ""
echo "=== STARTUP ORDER (systemd resolves based on After=/Requires=) ==="
echo "  1. network.target / network-online.target"
echo "  2. postgresql.service + redis.service (parallel, both required)"
echo "  3. api.service (after postgresql + redis)"
echo "  4. celery-worker.service (after redis)"
echo "  5. caddy.service (after api)"
echo ""
echo "To start the full stack:"
echo "  systemctl start app-stack.target"
echo ""
echo "To stop the full stack:"
echo "  systemctl stop app-stack.target"
echo ""
echo "To check status of all services:"
echo "  systemctl status 'caddy.service' 'api.service' 'postgresql.service' 'celery-worker.service' 'redis.service'"
```
